[ISBK.1.1] **Header (required).** `abi_version` gates the whole structure
(mismatch → `DS_ERR_BACKEND_ABI_VERSION`). `atom_field` binds the backend to one
of the seven backings of [NSBK.6.1]: it is the field number of the backing's
atom ([RFCS.16.1]), the number a `.dsc` carries the series' atom under, so the
loader keys a declaration to its backend with no translation. `supported_aggs` is a bitmask over the
`ds_series_agg_kind_t` ordinals; build it with `DS_SERIES_AGG_BIT(k)`.
`ds_series_agg_kind_t`, declared in libds's internal series header with the
vtable, must mirror `specs/registry/series_agg.ebnf` ([NSBK.6.3]) name for name
and value for value.
`backend_name` / `backend_version` are identity strings that feed the replay
platform signature ([NSBK.7.1]).
